import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Field {
        long v;

        Field(long x) {
            v = x % MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            if (v >= MOD) {
                System.err.println("Field error");
                System.exit(1);
            }
        }

        Field add(Field o) {
            return new Field((v + o.v) % MOD);
        }

        Field sub(Field o) {
            return new Field((v - o.v + MOD) % MOD);
        }

        Field mul(Field o) {
            return new Field((v * o.v) % MOD);
        }

        Field div(Field o) {
            return mul(o.inv());
        }

        void addTo(Field o) {
            v = (v + o.v) % MOD;
        }

        void subFrom(Field o) {
            v = (v - o.v + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        void mulBy(Field o) {
            v = (v * o.v) % MOD;
        }

        void divBy(Field o) {
            mulBy(o.inv());
        }

        Field inv() {
            long e = MOD - 2;
            long b = v;
            long r = 1;
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                    r = (r * b) % MOD;
                }
                b = (b * b) % MOD;
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return new Field(r);
        }
    }

    static Field[][] matmul(Field[][] A, Field[][] B) {
        int n = A.length;
        int m = A[0].length;
        int p = B[0].length;
        if (B.length != m) {
            System.err.println("matmul dim error");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        Field[][] C = new Field[n][p];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < p; ++j) {
                C[i][j] = new Field(0);
                for (int k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
                    C[i][j] = C[i][j].add(A[i][k].mul(B[k][j]));
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static Field[] matvec(Field[][] A, Field[] x) {
        int n = A.length;
        int m = A[0].length;
        if (x.length != m) {
            System.err.println("matvec dim error");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        Field[] y = new Field[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            y[i] = new Field(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                y[i] = y[i].add(A[i][j].mul(x[j]));
            }
        }
        return y;
    }

    static Field[][] matrix2D(int r, int c) {
        Field[][] result = new Field[r][c];
        for (int i = 0; i < r; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < c; ++j) {
                result[i][j] = new Field(0);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static Field[][][] matrix3D(int a, int b, int c) {
        Field[][][] result = new Field[a][b][c];
        for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < b; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < c; ++k) {
                    result[i][j][k] = new Field(0);
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        Field[][][] shift = matrix3D(d, d + 1, d + 1);
        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
                shift[k][i][(i + k) % d].v = 1;
            }
            shift[k][d][d].v = 1;
        }

        Field[][][] unit = matrix3D(d, d + 1, d + 1);
        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
                unit[k][i][i].v = 1;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
                unit[k][k][i].v = 1;
            }
        }

        Field[][] I = matrix2D(d + 1, d + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
            I[i][i].v = 1;
        }

        Map<Long, Field[][]> cache = new HashMap<>();

        class MatrixBuilder {
            Field[][] build(long p) {
                if (cache.containsKey(p)) {
                    return cache.get(p);
                }
                if (p <= d) {
                    Field[][] M = I;
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; ++k) {
                        M = matmul(unit[k], M);
                    }
                    cache.put(p, M);
                    return M;
                }
                long block = d;
                while ((p + block - 1) / block > d) {
                    block *= d;
                }
                Field[][] child = build(block);
                Field[][] M = child;
                long rem = p - block;
                for (int k = 1; k < d; ++k) {
                    if (rem >= block) {
                        M = matmul(matmul(matmul(shift[d - k], child), shift[k]), M);
                        rem -= block;
                    } else if (rem > 0) {
                        M = matmul(matmul(matmul(shift[d - k], build(rem)), shift[k]), M);
                        rem = 0;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                cache.put(p, M);
                return M;
            }
        }

        MatrixBuilder builder = new MatrixBuilder();
        Field[][] M = builder.build(n);
        Field[] base = new Field[d + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
            base[i] = new Field(0);
        }
        base[d].v = 1;
        Field[] ansVec = matvec(M, base);
        Field sum = new Field(0);
        for (Field x : ansVec) {
            sum.v = (sum.v + x.v) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(sum.v);
    }
}
